name: andoracle
description: Andoracle is an offline-capable desktop duophonic synthesizer PWA that recreates the ARP Odyssey signal flow with MIDI, note sequencing, delay, and patch sharing.

scripts.prebuild: npm run generate:icons && npm run generate:audio-keepalive
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --mode extension && node scripts/package-extensions.mjs
scripts.build:extensions: npm run generate:icons && npm run generate:audio-keepalive && tsc -b && vite build --mode extension && node scripts/package-extensions.mjs && node scripts/verify-extension-packages.mjs
